info.prompt: A dystopian casino-horror dice game where the safe zone collapses inward as six outer tiles carbonize first at the corners, their edges curling into blackened ash while the remaining play area pulses faster in warning. The artificer-class HUD tints everything in steampunk bronze, custom gear-shaped dice rotating slowly as a neural lattice flickers with stolen data packets. High-contrast lighting makes neon magenta UI elements bleed into the void black like digital bloodstains.
